issue.title: Stable Maestro selectors (Home, lists, Settings testIDs)
issue.body:
## Summary / context

Parent: #488.

Maestro should prefer `testID` / `id:` over visible copy. Auth, Record, Sync, and Prepare-for-Offline already have strong coverage; Home tabs, project/chapter lists, and Settings rows are thin.

## Current vs expected

**Current:** Login/record/sync/offline `testID`s exist; Home `TabBar`, project/chapter rows, many Settings rows rely on a11y labels or text only.

**Expected:** Semantic kebab-case `testID`s on every surface a smoke flow will tap or assert. Treat IDs as a **stable API** (rename only with flow updates).

## Scope

**In scope**
- Home: `home-screen`, My Work / Projects tab ids, sync header entry
- Lists: project row, chapter row (stable enough for Maestro)
- Drafting: ensure Bible / Resources / Record tab ids if missing
- Settings: row ids for Prepare Offline, cellular, drafting unit, add user, log out
- Drawer: gear / menu content already partially covered — fill gaps
- Brief convention note in code comment or short docs stub (playbook expands later)

**Out of scope**
- Writing Maestro YAML (later children)
- Visual redesign
- iOS

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Cold launch / post-login screens used by planned smokes have root + primary CTA `testID`s
- [ ] Home tabs and at least one project/chapter open path selectable by id
- [ ] Settings primary rows selectable by id
- [ ] No reliance on product marketing copy for primary paths
- [ ] Unit/component tests updated only where existing patterns already assert a11y/testIDs

## Verification / test plan

1. Manual inspect on emulator (or Maestro MCP later) that ids appear in hierarchy
2. `npm test -- --ci` green if tests touched

## Links

- Refs #488
- Depends on harness (# child) being usable, but selector PR can land independently
